description: Curated map of the browser API surface reachable from rsjs islands, keyed against MDN browser-compat-data (bcd_keys) and Baseline status. Statuses mirror the discipline of features.json: every API an island can reach is either supported or has a recorded reason it is not. Entry list derived from the web-features package (v3.30.0 sweep): every Baseline widely-available feature family exposing api.* compat keys gets a row, excluding CSS/HTML/SVG presentation features and deep sub-features (e.g. WebGL extensions, EME) which inherit their family's status. Refresh baseline values against web-features; refresh bcd_keys against @mdn/browser-compat-data.

statuses.supported: exposed to islands through the analyzed subset (event attrs, node refs, rsjs:: helpers)
statuses.helper_only: used internally by the RSJS runtime but not exposed to analyzed component code
statuses.rejected_by_design: deliberately blocked (security or architecture boundary); compiler rejects with a diagnostic
statuses.planned: not implemented; not part of the supported API
statuses.missing: no surface and no agreed direction yet
